Method of Attack: Sending massive amounts of spam via dynamic command and control (C&C) servers
Using a Domain Generation Algorithm (DGA) to generate unique URLs weekly for C&C communication
Abusing domain registrations (.ch and .biz) to host C&C servers
Discoverer: Swiss Governmental Computer Emergency Response Team (GovCERT)
Attack Vector: Malware infection leading to botnet participation
Use of exploit kits (historical relation with RIG exploit kit)
Indicators of Compromise: 20 random domains generated weekly by Tofsee variants (10 .ch domains, 10 .biz domains)
List of .biz domains published by GovCERT for blocking
Dynamic URLs generated by Tofsee's DGA
